185: On Rosh Hashanah, we pass before Him like sheep (benei maron): It is taught, Rosh Hashanah is the head (rosh) of the year of the King. And who is Rosh Hashanah? It is Yitzchak, who is called head. For he is one head of the King (a different version: [one head] above); a place called the year. Because of this, all that come into the world pass before Him like sheep. And about this we learned, "Upon Rosh Hashanah." For behold, Yitzchak dwells at the head of the year.
